name: Mr. Fetch
subtitle: only finds what you didn't know you needed
rules: UNIQUE PLUCK -- When this card enters play, you may remove a card in your discard pile from the game. If you do, draw a card. -- GOOD DEAL -- COST – Deplete this card. Pick 2 cards of the same type in your discard pile. Remove them from the game. EFFECT – Search your deck for a card with the same type as the picked cards and reveal it. If you do, put it into your hand.

name: Elementary Elemental
subtitle: adorably horrible
rules: If this card is destroyed, put it into its owner's hand, then discard a card.
flavor: Little Suzy suspected that today would have been a good day to stay home from the Arcanology Academy.
notes: Card prints 'If this card is destroyed'; catalog has 'When this card is destroyed'. Footer also credits 'original Open R&D concept by kallisti'.

name: Mittens of Muffled Thought
subtitle: can't brain so good today
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- The attached character cannot attack and has no rules text. -- MOVE -- COST – Pick a character that is not in battle. Pay 3. EFFECT – Attach this card to the character.

name: Gloamspike-Gosche Bridge
subtitle: the arcane crossing
rules: This card cannot be picked. -- All characters in your hand gain TACTICAL. -- [O][O][O][O][O][O][O][O] – All items and locations in your hand gain TACTICAL.
flavor: An invisible bridge stretches the passage between mainland Clockman and the isolated towers of the Clockman Arcanology Branch
notes: Third paragraph has 8 threshold icons (zoomed to count). Flavor has no final period.

name: Tedious TriAdic Truculence
subtitle: touch them with terror
rules: COST – Pick 3 characters with different names. -- EFFECT – Any opponent may pay 3. If they do, look at the top 3 cards of your deck and put them back in any order then terminate this card. Otherwise, destroy each picked character with 3 strength or less.
flavor: They try to teach the truth through the training of threes.
notes: Card COST is 'Pick 3 characters with different names' (catalog: 'Pick 3 characters'). Card EFFECT: opponent may pay 3; if they do, look at top 3 and terminate this card; Otherwise destroy each picked character with 3 strength or less. Catalog lacks 'with different names', has no 'Otherwise' (unconditional destroy as separate paragraph) and the 'Any opponent may pay 3' sentence is in the cost/effect order differently.
